$comment: Where this site’s committed data came from. Written when the folder was first committed; `bun run fetch grimma` and `bun run bake grimma` regenerate everything from the sources named here (raw downloads live in data/_raw/sn/, never committed).
retrieved: 2026-09-24 (provider products); Wikidata and the re-bake of the bridge steps 2026-09-27

provider.name: GeoSN (Landesamt für Geobasisinformation Sachsen)
products: Basis-DLM (land cover, tree rows, rail, bridges, monuments)

committed.data/grimma/dgm/: DGM1 per tile, clipped to the 2 km grid and written compact (DEFLATE, float predictor, centimetres) by `bun run fetch`
committed.data/grimma/cityjson/: LoD2 per tile, converted from the provider’s CityGML by pipeline/bake/citygml.py
committed.data/grimma/dlm/: the derived per-tile artifacts of `bun run bake` (class raster, canopy, vegetation, OSM layers, …)
committed.data/grimma/dop/: per-tile values derived from the orthophoto (roof colours)

openstreetmap.licence: Open Database License (ODbL); credit: © OpenStreetMap contributors
openstreetmap.extract: a stand-in: BBBike city extract Leipzig.osm.pbf (download.bbbike.org), because download.geofabrik.de was unreachable from the build container
openstreetmap.usedFor: walls, stairs, lamps, street furniture, fountains, paving, markings, trams, riverside, sport, shops and heritage

osmBuildings.dataAsOf: 2026-10-31 (re-baked 2026-11-01 with every step from the BBBike city extract Leipzig.osm.pbf, Last-Modified 2026-10-31 16:41 UTC)

all.dataAsOf: 2026-10-31 (re-baked 2026-11-01 with every step from the BBBike city extract Leipzig.osm.pbf, Last-Modified 2026-10-31 16:41 UTC)

wikidata.usedFor: bridge names and types, cached per tile under data/_raw/sn/wikidata/

traffic.title: Straßenverkehrszählung 2021 (SVZ), Landesamt für Straßenbau und Verkehr
traffic.coverage: federal, state and district roads, both directions together, with the heavy-goods share; split evenly between the directions (sp 1)

sections.$comment: per tile bbox incl. the 50 m margin, before the clip

Basis-DLM.editionInUse: every derived file: the package released 2026-10-20 (basisdlm_akt.csv and the inner package dated 2026-10-20), downloaded and baked 2026-11-01
